appearance_facts.location: US Population by State (in Millions) map
appearance_facts.fact: California and Texas are filled with the darkest orange color (30+ M band). Florida is filled with purple (20-30 M band). Other labeled states like New York, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Ohio, Michigan, Georgia, and North Carolina are filled with green (10-20 M band).
California is located on the West Coast. Texas is located in the South-Central region. Florida is located in the Southeast. The legend is positioned on the right side of the map.

printed_facts.fact: Color scale: Red = 0-5 M, Blue = 5-10 M, Green = 10-20 M, Purple = 20-30 M, Orange = 30+ M.
California, Texas, Florida, New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Michigan, Illinois, Georgia, North Carolina.

public_definitions: Task: Review the population dashboard, then open the state detail record that should be routed into the highest-population public statistics follow-up workflow.
Primary Field: Highest-population state detail route
Options: Open California population detail for priority follow-up, Open Texas population detail for priority follow-up, Open Florida population detail for priority follow-up
uncertain: The map shows California and Texas in the same highest population category (30+ M). Without specific numerical values, it is visually ambiguous which of the two is strictly higher, though California is traditionally the most populous.
